Luminescent Veil: Grants allies 40% Evasion, decreasing by 10% per successful evade to 20%, Max 2 per card. Gain 10% of prevented Damage 200% Cap. Does not work against Kira or Judgment Day.
Bind Fate: On entry, permanently link the first 2 enemies. Damage dealt to one is shared with the other.
Ouroboros: Upon entry, steals 5% of all other cards' stats, including allies. Stolen stats decay after 3 turns.
Divine Ascension: Enemy's hit chance is squared ratio of damage to your Max HP. On first Death Awaken instead.
Mastered Ascension: Gain 1.5X Stats, dodge every other attack.
Cosmic Rivalry: On entry, attack with 3X damage. +10% stats and Damage Reduction each turn.
Kitchen: On entry open a Domain and disable all enemy defense abilities, Slashes opponent 2-5 times dealing 35% damage each.
Six Realms Staff: On entry, manifest 1 of 6 weapons, gaining its unique ability.
Vajra Short Sword: 40% chance to parry an attack, taking no damage and reflecting 75% of its damage, capped at 75% of current HP.
Staff of Perfect Enlightenment: Deals 25% increased damage with a 25% chance to stun. Ignores defensive abilities.
Shield of Ahimsa: Gain a shield every other turn and take 35% less damage.
War Scythe: On entry, attack the first 2 enemies, bypassing defensive and on-death abilities.
Great Nirvana Sword - Zero: On entry, gain the effects of 2 random Six Realms weapons.
Ruler of Humans: Doesn't attack. All damage taken (x1.25) is added to your party's attack.
Split In Two: On death, split into Joy and Sorrow. Each inherits 50% of Max HP and 60% of Damage, entering battle one after another.
Joy: inherits 50% of Max HP and 60% of Damage of The Broken One
Sorrow: inherits 50% of Max HP and 60% of Damage of The Broken One
Jackpot: 30% chance to critically strike, dealing 50% increased Damage. Critical strikes immediately trigger a follow-up attack dealing 50% Damage.
Spartan's Rage: For every 1% of Max HP lost, gain 1% increased Damage. Additionally, gain 0.5% Lifesteal for every 1% of Max HP lost.
Black Box: The first time NO.2 would die, her Black Box overloads. She survives at 1 HP and deals damage equal to 50% of her Max HP to the enemy.
Blade of Miquella: Attacks restore HP equal to 25% of Damage dealt. Every third attack performs Waterfowl Dance, striking 3 times for 50% Damage each.
Life Tap: Before attacking, sacrifice 15% of current HP to gain 30% increased Damage. Defeating an enemy restores 20% of Max HP.
Frozen Solitude: While active, Freeze each enemy on their first turn. Deal 100% increased Damage to Frozen enemies.
Cry: Whenever Isaac takes Damage, gain a Tear. Each Tear gives +1 Turn and 15% stats
Fortify: After attacking, place a Block in front of Steve. Each Block absorbs 40% of his Max HP in Damage. Steve can have up to 3 Blocks at once.
Divine Arrogance: Deal 75% increased Damage while above the enemy's HP. While below the enemy's HP, take 45% reduced Damage instead.
Void Heart: Each turn gain 1 Void stack. At 3 Void, consume them to make the next attack deal 100% increased Damage and heal 25% Max HP.
Shade: On death, leave behind a Shade with 25% of Max HP and 50% of Damage.
Hidden Blade: The first attack against each enemy deals 100% increased Damage and ignores defensive abilities.
The D8: On Entry, roll the D6 to randomly gain 1-50% Damage, 1-50% Max HP, and 1-30% Damage Reduction for the battle.
Glory Kill: Defeating an enemy fully restores HP and permanently increases Damage by 50%, stacking with each kill.
Trick or Treat!: On entry, 50% chance for a Treat (+25% ATK and heal 20% Max HP), otherwise play a Trick (reduce enemy ATK by 25%).
Get Off My Lawn!: When attacked, counterattack for 40% Damage. The first counterattack also reduces the enemy's ATK by 20%.
Venomous Web: Attacks inflict Poison for 2 turns. Poisoned enemies also have a 20% chance to miss their next attack.
Intangible: 35% chance to evade attacks. After successfully evading, its next attack deals 50% increased Damage.
Primal Rage: Gain 50% Damage every time this card is attacked, stacking up to +150%.
Murder of Crows: On entry, attack all enemies for 20% Damage. Every third attack, attack the entire enemy team for 30% Damage.
Withering Curse: On entry, curse the enemy. Cursed enemies lose 25% ATK and Accuracy at the end of their turns, stacking up to 75%.
The Eight Pages: While alive and in party Gain 1 Page each allied turn (maximum 8). Each Page grants +20% ATK and +5% Evasion.
Cursed Orchard: Attacks plant a cursed seed in the enemy. After 2 enemy turns, the seed bursts, dealing 100% of Eerie Tree's Damage
Haunted Heirloom: Take 75% Reduced damage for 2 turns. On death, the armor moves to the next ally, granting it 40% Damage Reduction for 3 turns.
Stone Vigil: Every other turn, enter Stone Form, taking 80% less Damage but unable to attack. On awakening, strike for 2x Damage.
Never Fall Asleep: Every attack inflicts 1 Fatigue stack. At 2 stacks, the enemy falls asleep. Attacks against a sleeping enemy deals 2X Damage
King of Horror: On entry, other Halloween allies gain +25% Stats. Gain the total flat stat increases granted to them.
